cohort: 45,213 obstetric patients who delivered between January 1, 2007, and December 31, 2013
finding: The risk of RBCT increased over the study period for cesarean deliveries, with unavailable or low hemoglobin levels being strongly associated with RBCT in this group.
mod_finding: Cesarean sections had a higher rate of RBCT compared to other modes of delivery (2.3% vs 0.7% for spontaneous vaginal delivery and 1.5% for instrumental delivery, p < 0.001)
gest_age: Earlier gestational age at induction increased the risk of RBCT across all modes of delivery
